prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review a delivery Live Activity proposed for iPhone Lock Screen. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. It starts automatically for promotional offers with no active delivery, shows the customer’s full address on Lock Screen, labels a 40-minute-old estimate Now, keeps displaying Delivered forever and puts a complete shopping catalog inside expanded content.

criteria.task_completion: Find the five seeded purpose/privacy/freshness/lifecycle/scope defects, then specify bounded delivery states and useful Lock Screen/Dynamic Island hierarchy.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the live-activities guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Find the five seeded purpose/privacy/freshness/lifecycle/scope defects, then specify bounded delivery states and useful Lock Screen/Dynamic Island hierarchy.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Find the five seeded purpose/privacy/freshness/lifecycle/scope defects, then specify bounded delivery states and useful Lock Screen/Dynamic Island hierarchy.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Promotion without a bounded active task is an inappropriate activity purpose.
Full customer address exposes sensitive Lock Screen content.
Old estimate is falsely presented as current.
Catalog content exceeds immediately useful bounded-task scope.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
